name: Microsoft Copilot SDK
description: Embeds the agent runtime behind Copilot CLI in your own apps, with TypeScript, Python, Go, .NET, Java, and Rust SDKs that handle planning, tool calls, and file edits.

skills.name: Custom Agents
skills.description: Defines specialized sub-agents with scoped tools and instructions inside a Copilot session.

skills.name: Hooks
skills.description: Intercepts session behavior to control tool execution, transform results, and handle errors.

skills.name: MCP Servers
skills.description: Connects Model Context Protocol servers to a session for external tool access.

skills.name: Fleet Mode
skills.description: Dispatches multiple sub-agents in parallel for large, independent workstreams.

skills.name: Bring Your Own Key
skills.description: Uses your own OpenAI, Microsoft Foundry, or Anthropic API keys instead of GitHub Copilot authentication.
